purpose: 3-turn dialect/register detection and locking. In v1 always returns 'standard' + 'তুমি'. In v2, detect_dialect() and detect_register() use these maps.

তুই.use_when: Close friend, younger sibling, child, very informal contexts
তুই.warning: Mis-using তুই with elder = grave offense. Default to তুমি unless 90%+ confident.

তুমি.use_when: Default for daily companion. Friends, family, peers.

আপনি.use_when: Elders, strangers, professional contexts, when discussing respected figures

dhaka.phonetic_signal: Drops final ই, replaces ছ with chh aspiration

sylheti.phonetic_signal: Distinct fricatives, often considered separate language
sylheti.warning: If detected, may need separate Sylheti specialist in v3

chittagonian.phonetic_signal: Tonal features uncommon to other Bangla dialects

detection_strategy_v2.turn_1: Listen. Respond in standard Bangla, তুমি register.
detection_strategy_v2.turn_2: Score user utterance against dialect markers + register triggers. Build hypothesis.
detection_strategy_v2.turn_3: Confirm hypothesis or default to standard. Lock for session.
detection_strategy_v2.lock_persistence: Per-user, persisted across sessions. User can override via settings.

v1_default_behavior.note: v1 ships safe defaults. detect_dialect() always returns 'standard'. Register locking inactive.
